_about: CM-061 part 1 (rewrite 3 §3.1): every input the system collects for a client — its file patterns (relative to clients/<slug>/, matched in order, first match wins), what it holds, what it can support, and the steps that MUST read it (scripts/gates.json → steps → reads must name `ref` for each step in read_by; tests check it). A raw file that only a script converts names the entry it feeds in `raw_of`. scope 'system' = a file outside the client folder. records.py lists any input on file that no finished step has read (STATUS.md, 'Data on file not used yet'). scripts/manifest.py checks and reports.
